title: eat shit & die 157
author: bpatrick
html: Onan is so fun to draw. My schedule has gotten lighter for the summer so hopefully I’ll be able to crank on some comics and update like a motherfucker.
postClass: post-535 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-eatshitanddie tag-onan uentry post-comic postonpage-1 odd post-author-bpatrick

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: Jonny Paycheck: Seriously? I was under the impression no one liked them but me. I can do more Onan for sure.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: I could write an essay on why I like Onan so much, but I think I’ll save that rant for when you make the next page 🙂

comments.author: randomguy
comments.html: omg, for the longest time my friends and i always have conversations of how one day roaches will rule the world! and you sort of visually described our convo’s with this! awesome! how about a world where animals are replaced with roaches.. street cat, dog, flock of duck sized roaches.. they need to be eradicated.. -anyway loved the strip.

comments.author: Evan B.
comments.html: For whatever it’s worth I find “Onan: The Last Boy” much cooler than “Onan: The Last Boy in the Universe”. Don’t know why.

comments.author: Sydney
comments.html: Onan is great, love to see more
